title: Congestion Knobs & Tiered Burst Templates — Dedicated GPU Pool Controls UI
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Design a compact, operational-first UI surface for per-GPU-pool congestion management and two-tier burst templates. The intent is to give SREs and platform engineers clear, low-risk controls that balance latency SLOs and cost targets. Key features: 1) 'Congestion Knobs' grouped into Operational Safety (max concurrency, queue depth, backpressure policy) and Economics (burst budget, sustained burst cap, cost guardrail). 2) Tiered burst templates (short burst vs sustained burst) that can be saved, versioned, and rolled out via canary. 3) Visual affordances for risk (predicted tail latency, expected cost delta, impact estimate) and quick rollback. 4) RBAC-aware edit flows + audit log links. Design must align with Redwood Console tokens, be responsive, and include accessible labels and keyboard flows.
acceptance_criteria: Figma prototype (interactive) linked and reviewed by Eng + PM
Component spec exported to Storybook with tokens and states
Handoff document listing behavior for each knob + guardrail validations
Rollback/preview states defined and can be invoked in prototype
Design validated in two 30-minute internal usability sessions with SREs and PMs
Accessibility checklist passed for all controls (labels, focus order, contrast)
